business_problem: Zhaopin needed a large-model architecture that could optimize the whole recruiting workflow, because isolated AI features were not enough for a process that spans job creation, resume review, candidate communication, interviewing, and job-candidate matching.
solution_summary: Zhaopin worked with Baidu AI Cloud to rebuild recruiting around its AI assistant Ailin and the Qianfan large-model platform. Rather than stopping at single-point features, the implementation used large models across position publishing, resume screening, quick response, precise recommendation, candidate communication, and interviewing, giving HR teams one connected workflow. Qianfan and ERNIE support candidate-job matching, AI interviews, and AI-generated interview questions, while Zhaopin's own domain content and job-market data provide the recruiting-specific context. The architecture also includes a teacher-student distillation pattern: Zhaopin uses DeepSeek-R1 as a teacher model, distills datasets from it, and tunes ERNIE Speed as a lighter student model so it can preserve experience while sharply cutting inference cost. This produces an end-to-end intelligent recruiting service that supports both enterprise recruiters and job seekers with faster matching, richer candidate understanding, and better explanation of recommendations.

solution_components.name: Ailin
solution_components.role: Acts as the recruiting assistant that helps HR teams manage the workflow from job posting through screening, communication, recommendation, and interviewing.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model environment Zhaopin uses to improve job matching, AI interviewing, and AI-generated question creation across the recruiting journey.

solution_components.name: ERNIE Speed
solution_components.role: Serves as the tuned student model that preserves recruiting performance while lowering inference cost after distillation from a larger teacher model.

data_flow: Recruiter and job-seeker information flows into Ailin and the recruiting workflow, Qianfan and Zhaopin's domain data generate matching, interview, and recommendation outputs, and distilled ERNIE Speed models serve the resulting experience at lower runtime cost.
business_outcome: Zhaopin improved matching accuracy, lowered inference cost, and turned recruiting into a more connected and explainable workflow for both HR teams and candidates.
architecture_clues: The system uses a teacher-student distillation pattern with DeepSeek-R1 as teacher and ERNIE Speed as student.
Ailin covers the recruiting flow from job posting through interview management instead of a single AI feature.
The implementation spans both B-side recruiters and C-side job seekers with the same matching core.
